note: KLHL20 is established as causing a neurodevelopmental disorder with early-onset seizures, facial dysmorphism, and behavioral abnormalities (OMIM #621390), supporting its phenotypic distinction from non-dysmorphic DEEs.

evidence.text: The identification of KLHL20 as a causative gene for a rare neurodevelopmental disorder emerged from studies examining autism spectrum disorder, behavioral abnormalities, intellectual disability, and facial phenotyping/dysmorphism.

source.title: MOLECULAR DIAGNOSTICS IN AUTISM SPECTRUM DISORDER: NEXT GENERATION SEQUENCING AND FACIAL PHENOTYPING IN MEDICAL GENETICS
